newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka ruling coalition sweeps local polls.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka ruling coalition sweeps local polls.

text.p: Sri Lanka's ruling People's Alliance (PA) coalition won a landslide victory in local polls on Saturday, taking more than 80 percent of the 225 councils where results were declared, state radio reported.

The radio quoted officials of the Election Department as saying that PA had won 184 local councils and the main opposition United National Party 40 in polls for 238 municipal, urban and other smaller bodies held on Friday.
One local council was won by an independent group, state radio reported.
Results for the remaining 13 councils were expected soon.
Officials said the PA has won a larger percentage of votes in rural areas while the UNP performed better in urban centres.
